prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup
Asset type: TALKPIK AI auth screen redesign concept
Input image role: the visible source screenshot is a reference image for layout, state, and information architecture, not an edit target.
Primary request: Redesign 01-A-01-sign-up/default.
Direction: quiet split-auth study desk.
Composition/framing: desktop 1280x900 web app screenshot, no browser chrome and no OS window frame. Keep the new account creation purpose: left brand and subtle mascot support area, right sign-up form with name, email, password, password confirmation, strength indicator, terms/privacy agreement, primary sign-up CTA, Google sign-up, and login return link.
Style/medium: high-fidelity web UI mockup, Ant Design-friendly Form/Input/Button/Checkbox structure.
Color palette: Mist #f4f4f5 canvas, Snow #ffffff form card, Fog #ececee secondary surfaces, Obsidian #09090b primary CTA only. Remove the loud purple/orange/yellow mascot blocks and use neutral character accents.
Typography: Cosmica-like single sans font, compact density, weight-driven hierarchy, no letter spacing.
Constraints: agreement links must remain visible; validation and disabled/ready CTA space should be present; Korean UI text is visual direction only and not final copy source.
Avoid: browser chrome, OS window frame, loud AI gradients, chromatic CTAs, repeated bright accents, oversized 28-36px workspace radii, heavy shadows, marketing hero clutter, watermark.
